feature_leads.name: Christmas cave / מערת חג המולד
feature_leads.source_claim: Accessible lower-Kidron cave; earlier coins plus a second-year Bar Kokhba coin. Agrippa I coin pictured as found in the cave; Nerva denarius caption says near the cave.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Authors infer First Revolt and Bar Kokhba use; mint date is not deposition date.
feature_leads.coordinate_system: EPSG2039 source point converted to WGS84; cave-level accuracy unspecified
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Recover original bags and trench maps for IAA582928, IAA582931 and IAA585440; published lab/accession joins completed.

additional_source_grid.coordinate_system: New Israel Grid as printed in Rasmussen et al. 2022 p.2

feature_leads.name: Coin cave / מערת המטבע and neighboring caves
feature_leads.source_claim: Bar-Adon excavations 1970/1976 and shepherd reuse; early/later Roman coin and lamp observations also refer to neighboring caves.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Do not assign neighboring finds to Coin cave.
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Separate cave numbers and survey/archive observations.

feature_leads.name: Salvadora cave; photograph label 143
feature_leads.source_claim: Early Roman finds and objects from a rock fissure; 1971 Bar-Adon excavation described as unpublished in 2009.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Early Roman material reported, exact deposit phase unverified.
feature_leads.coordinate_system: Provisional interpretation: EPSG28191 old-grid components in 10 m units; source position accuracy unspecified
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Arrowhead crack located in 2009 Fig4; obtain original 1971 object/layer records and check later publication status.

feature_leads.name: Te’enim western cave
feature_leads.source_claim: Early Roman pottery and Herodian lamp fragment in western cave.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Early Roman material, not a dated cache.
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Recover western entrance/plan and locate pottery and lamp contexts separately.

feature_leads.name: Te’enim southern cave
feature_leads.source_claim: Whole spear in narrow rock crack.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Authors interpret short Bar Kokhba use; separate from western cave.
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Recover crack dimensions and original dating context.

feature_leads.name: Romah complex and Naqb el-Mardeh
feature_leads.source_claim: Five caves with third-year Bar Kokhba coins and occupation material; aerial photo marks path and cave clusters.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Later revolt evidence does not establish scroll-period use.
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Obtain controlled survey map and path chronology.

feature_leads.name: Dinar cave
feature_leads.source_claim: Relatively accessible cave with small walls, third-year revolt coin and weapon evidence.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Bar Kokhba; interpreted as lookout/ambush rather than standard prolonged refuge.
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Compare water and access requirements with securely dated refuge caves.

feature_leads.name: Har Yishai / Cabar complexes
feature_leads.source_claim: Early Roman and later revolt material; installations at some features.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Installation phase and occupation phase must be separated.
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Trace inherited Bar-Adon records and assign each find to the correct cave.

feature_leads.name: Bir el-Amara / ביר אלמעארה
feature_leads.source_claim: Large cistern and old stone troughs.
feature_leads.period_evidence: No secure installation/use date given in inspected guide text.
feature_leads.coordinate_system: source grid notation; CRS and feature assignment unverified
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Seek original plan and dating of each trough.

feature_leads.name: Abu Shuʿla dam, Hyrcania northern aqueduct
feature_leads.source_claim: Dressed-stone dam diverts runoff to south-bank aqueduct; continuation assigns it to Hyrcania northern system, 1.2 km.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Guide broadly assigns Hasmonean/Herodian system; individual phase requires primary report.
feature_leads.coordinate_system: Provisional interpretation: EPSG28191 source components in 100 m units; guide point, not surveyed station44
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Regional trial disagrees with guide grid by about244m. Resolve map generalization, grid notation and intake identity using survey coordinates.
feature_leads.primary_comparison: Patrich1989 station44; geographic identity not confirmed by trial registration.

feature_leads.name: Mar Saba canyon entrance
feature_leads.source_claim: Start of narrow canyon section, north-to-south, about 3 km long.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Modern terrain description, not period cairn evidence.
feature_leads.coordinate_system: source grid notation; CRS and feature assignment unverified
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Test entrance sense of gorge-mouth against entry readings and dated route features.

feature_leads.name: Southern end of Mar Saba canyon
feature_leads.source_claim: Canyon section ends near Small Lavra ridge, before river turns east into basin.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Modern terrain; Byzantine landmark is not a first-century date.
feature_leads.coordinate_system: source grid notation; CRS and feature assignment unverified
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Test upper-gorge outlet model; recover any period cairn or separate dam intake.

feature_leads.name: Kidron transition into Hyrcania basin
feature_leads.source_claim: River enters open basin at the given grid.
feature_leads.coordinate_system: source grid notation; CRS and feature assignment unverified
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Use as control separating canyon and basin segments.

feature_leads.name: Lower Kidron steep canyon start
feature_leads.source_claim: Beginning of steep lower canyon, approximately 3 km long.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Modern terrain description, no dated heap.
feature_leads.coordinate_system: source grid notation; CRS and feature assignment unverified
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Keep entrance distinct from cliff exit; register source map.

feature_leads.name: Kidron stream outlet
feature_leads.source_claim: Outlet grid in site heading; lower reach follows alluvial fan to Dead Sea.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Modern geography and shoreline, not exact ancient mouth.
feature_leads.coordinate_system: source grid notation; CRS and feature assignment unverified
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Locate cliff exit separately and test eastern model with ancient shoreline uncertainty.

feature_leads.name: Hyrcania stepped tunnels
feature_leads.source_claim: Northern slope tunnel about 30 m deep; second blocked tunnel about 300 m away; purpose explicitly uncertain.
feature_leads.period_evidence: Mithraic comparison is interpretation, not demonstrated phase.
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Find excavation plans and stratigraphy before assigning a scroll feature.
feature_leads.do_not_merge_with: Patrich 1989 station 49: southwest covered passage, surviving 11.5 m, pp.257–259.

feature_leads.name: Ein Feshkha PEF rock benchmark
feature_leads.source_claim: PEF/Masterman 1900–1913 measurements and Koppe 1917 height calibration.
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Recover original benchmark datum, notebooks and repeat photographs.

feature_leads.name: Rujm el-Bahr shoreline / jetty photographs
feature_leads.period_evidence: Modern shoreline, not ancient lake level.
feature_leads.status: source lead, no identified Copper Scroll deposit
feature_leads.next_test: Recover original images with dates, camera positions and datum control.

constraints: Raw grids locate source-described features, not Copper Scroll deposits.
Cave leads have no assigned entry match.
Period evidence, installation dates, and coin mint dates are separate.

excluded_model.claim: Qumran flooded at about -330 m during Herod
excluded_model.reason: Older inferred reconstruction conflicts with Bookman et al. 2004 reported late Holocene range -390 to -415 m; white band origin/date not independently established here.
excluded_model.checked_extent: abstract only, not full sample table
